If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Exchanges are handled as a refund + new purchase.
There isn’t a built-in “exchange” button. The usual flow is:
Refund the original purchase.
The recipient then buys the product they want instead.
How the refund works:
From the Kajabi dashboard, click Sales.
Click Payments.
Open the Transactions tab.
Find the transaction.
Click the … (More Actions) button.
Select Refund.
Enter the refund amount and confirm. 
You can also open the transaction to review details or send receipts from the transaction page. 
Many creators also share a clear refund or exchange policy on their site so customers know the process before buying.
